pages.text: Watch the direction a trap faces. Avoid the firing line of arrow traps and step around floor hazards. Poison, burning, smoke, and tar traps are different blocks. Carry a suitable pickaxe and use it to disable a pyramid trap.
A Quandary Block lights up when a lit Nebu Torch is placed against its active face. At paired switches, light both sides. The matching limestone wall between them can turn into a hidden double door.
Player-owned traps can be opened to add fuel and disabled with a redstone signal. Pyramid traps already have power and block normal inventory access.
